item.title: The School Trip Tomorrow
item.summary: A teacher tells the class about tomorrow's trip to the botanical garden.
item.transcript_text: Good morning, class. Tomorrow we have a school trip to the botanical garden. The bus leaves at nine o'clock, so please come to school at half past eight. Please bring a hat and a bottle of water. It is very hot in the afternoon. We have lunch in the garden at one o'clock. You can bring sandwiches or fruit from home. Please do not bring a big bag. We come back to school at three o'clock. See you tomorrow!
